queries.name: catalog_keyset
queries.sql:
SELECT products.shop_id, products.name, products.price_uzs, products.price_confidence, products.telegram_file_id, products.source, products.channel_message_id, products.channel_chat_id, products.media_group_id, products.caption_raw, products.indexed_at, products.finalized_at, products.deleted_at, products.active, products.id, products.created_at, products.updated_at 
FROM products 
WHERE products.shop_id = $1::BIGINT AND products.active IS true AND products.deleted_at IS NULL AND products.finalized_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY products.indexed_at DESC, products.id DESC 
 LIMIT $2::INTEGER

queries.name: catalog_choice
queries.sql:
SELECT products.shop_id, products.name, products.price_uzs, products.price_confidence, products.telegram_file_id, products.source, products.channel_message_id, products.channel_chat_id, products.media_group_id, products.caption_raw, products.indexed_at, products.finalized_at, products.deleted_at, products.active, products.id, products.created_at, products.updated_at 
FROM products 
WHERE products.shop_id = $1::BIGINT AND products.active IS true AND products.deleted_at IS NULL AND products.finalized_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY $2::BOOLEAN DESC, products.indexed_at DESC, products.id DESC 
 LIMIT $3::INTEGER

queries.name: shop_customers
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM customers WHERE shop_id = $1

queries.name: shop_customers
queries.sql:
SELECT c.id, c.phone, c.created_at AS since,
           (SELECT count(*) FROM occasions o
              JOIN recipients r ON r.id = o.recipient_id AND r.shop_id = $1
             WHERE o.shop_id = $1 AND o.customer_id = c.id
               AND o.active AND r.active) AS saved_dates,
           (SELECT count(*) FROM orders x
             WHERE x.shop_id = $1 AND x.customer_id = c.id) AS orders,
           (SELECT max(x.created_at) FROM orders x
             WHERE x.shop_id = $1 AND x.customer_id = c.id) AS last_order_at
      FROM customers c
     WHERE c.shop_id = $1
     ORDER BY last_order_at DESC NULLS LAST, c.id DESC
 LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3

queries.name: shop_orders
queries.sql:
SELECT x.id, x.created_at, x.delivery_date, x.product_name_snapshot AS product,
               x.price_uzs_snapshot AS price_uzs, x.status, x.source, c.phone
          FROM orders x
          JOIN customers c ON c.id = x.customer_id AND c.shop_id = $1
         WHERE x.shop_id = $1
         ORDER BY x.created_at DESC, x.id DESC
     LIMIT $2

queries.name: admin_shops
queries.sql:
SELECT s.id, s.name, s.status, s.created_at, s.subscription_status, s.paid_until,
           s.gift_premium_after_order, s.group_chat_id, s.channel_id,
           h.bot_username, h.token_valid, h.channel_ok, h.group_ok, h.checked_at,
           h.detail ? 'bot' AS no_bot, rt.state AS runtime,
           rt.updated_at AS runtime_updated_at,
           (SELECT max(p.indexed_at) FROM products p
             WHERE p.shop_id = s.id AND p.finalized_at IS NOT NULL) AS last_indexed_at,
           (SELECT count(*) FROM products p
             WHERE p.shop_id = s.id AND p.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
               AND p.active AND p.deleted_at IS NULL) AS bouquets,
           (SELECT count(*) FROM customers c WHERE c.shop_id = s.id) AS customers,
           (SELECT count(*) FROM orders o
             WHERE o.shop_id = s.id AND o.created_at > $1) AS orders_30d,
           (SELECT coalesce(sum(ph.size_bytes), 0) FROM share_page_photos ph
             WHERE ph.shop_id = s.id AND ph.data IS NOT NULL) AS photo_bytes
      FROM shops s
      LEFT JOIN shop_runtime_states rt ON rt.shop_id = s.id
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT bot_username, token_valid, channel_ok, group_ok, checked_at, detail
              FROM shop_health_snapshots x
             WHERE x.shop_id = s.id
             ORDER BY x.checked_at DESC
             LIMIT 1) h ON true
     ORDER BY s.name, s.id

Plans.Filter: ((finalized_at IS NOT NULL) AND active AND (deleted_at IS NULL) AND (shop_id = s.id))

queries.name: order_card
queries.sql:
SELECT orders.id, orders.product_name_snapshot, orders.price_uzs_snapshot, orders.telegram_file_id_snapshot, orders.delivery_date, orders.delivery_hour, orders.delivery_location_text, orders.delivery_location_lat, orders.delivery_location_lon, orders.landmark, orders.recipient_name, customers.telegram_user_id, customers.phone, customers.phone_verified 
FROM orders JOIN customers ON customers.id = orders.customer_id 
WHERE orders.id = $1::BIGINT

queries.name: reminder_selection
queries.sql:
SELECT scheduled_notifications.shop_id, scheduled_notifications.customer_id, scheduled_notifications.occasion_id, scheduled_notifications.holiday, scheduled_notifications.occurrence_year, scheduled_notifications.offset_days, scheduled_notifications.due_at_utc, scheduled_notifications.channel, scheduled_notifications.state, scheduled_notifications.attempts, scheduled_notifications.sent_at, scheduled_notifications.merge_key, scheduled_notifications.created_at, scheduled_notifications.id 
FROM scheduled_notifications 
WHERE scheduled_notifications.state IN ($5::VARCHAR, $6::VARCHAR) AND scheduled_notifications.due_at_utc <= $1::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE AND (scheduled_notifications.shop_id NOT IN (SELECT shops.id 
FROM shops 
WHERE shops.status = $2::VARCHAR)) AND (scheduled_notifications.merge_key IS NULL OR scheduled_notifications.id = (SELECT min(scheduled_notifications_1.id) AS min_1 
FROM scheduled_notifications AS scheduled_notifications_1 
WHERE scheduled_notifications_1.customer_id = scheduled_notifications.customer_id AND scheduled_notifications_1.merge_key = scheduled_notifications.merge_key AND scheduled_notifications_1.state IN ($7::VARCHAR, $8::VARCHAR) AND scheduled_notifications_1.due_at_utc <= $3::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE)) ORDER BY scheduled_notifications.due_at_utc, scheduled_notifications.id 
 LIMIT $4::INTEGER FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

Plans.Filter: (((state)::text = ANY ('{pending,failed}'::text[])) AND (due_at_utc <= '2027-03-08 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (customer_id = scheduled_notifications.customer_id))

queries.name: pending_order_claim
queries.sql:
UPDATE order_reminders SET state=$1::VARCHAR, attempts=(order_reminders.attempts + $2::INTEGER), claimed_at=$3::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE WHERE order_reminders.id IN (SELECT order_reminders.id 
FROM order_reminders 
WHERE order_reminders.due_at_utc <= $4::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE AND (order_reminders.state IN ($8::VARCHAR, $9::VARCHAR) OR order_reminders.state = $5::VARCHAR AND order_reminders.claimed_at < $6::TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE) ORDER BY order_reminders.due_at_utc, order_reminders.id 
 LIMIT $7::INTEGER FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) RETURNING order_reminders.shop_id, order_reminders.order_id, order_reminders.ping_number, order_reminders.due_at_utc, order_reminders.state, order_reminders.attempts, order_reminders.sent_at, order_reminders.claimed_at, order_reminders.created_at, order_reminders.id

Plans.Recheck Cond: ((((state)::text = ANY ('{pending,failed}'::text[])) AND (due_at_utc <= '2027-03-08 05:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone)) OR (((state)::text = 'sending'::text) AND (due_at_utc <= '2027-03-08 05:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone)))
Plans.Filter: (((state)::text = ANY ('{pending,failed}'::text[])) OR (((state)::text = 'sending'::text) AND (claimed_at < '2027-03-08 04:55:00+00'::timestamp with time zone)))
